gpu_tip: ~24GB total at 128K context — the full-precision build, and a little more than a 24GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4090 or RTX 3090) holds on its own at full context. It is a dense build, so llama.cpp offloads whole layers to system RAM to cover the rest, and every layer that spills costs real speed; the quantized builds below leave much more headroom.
mac_tip: Needs ~24GB — too tight for a 24GB MacBook Pro once macOS takes its share; a 32GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro, M5, or M5 Pro) fits it comfortably.
